# Rev. Mark L. Moody

> Official website and book index for Rev. Mark L. Moody, retired evangelical pastor, Bible teacher, and author of scripture-rich investigations exploring the Lord's Supper and the Sabbath–Sunday question.

## Published Books

- **Communion's Forgotten Story: Reclaiming What We Lost**: Traces the Lord's Supper from Eden through Passover into the early church and today, written for Christians across all traditions. All author proceeds directly support missionary healthcare and education in Kijabe, Kenya.
  - Paperback: https://link.amazon/B0ciSrOaV
  - Hardcover: https://link.amazon/B04iw9IRl
  - Free 12-Session Study Guide (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Ge6kl348dqpOPxWMjKifScObTWFVw9bk/view?usp=sharing
  - Printed Study Guide Companion (*A Small Group Companion*): https://link.amazon/B0fivDLKu

- **Sincerely Mistaken: The Sabbath–Sunday Question**: A personal and conversational examination of the Sabbath-Sunday question written at approximately a Grade 7–9 reading level, chronicling a pastor's journey examining long-held assumptions in the light of Scripture.
  - Paperback: https://link.amazon/B0cTA3N13
  - Hardcover: https://link.amazon/B08No0Gq5
  - Study Guide Companion (*Sincerely Mistaken Study Guide: A Small Group Companion*): https://link.amazon/B0iVjIUYC

- **The Sabbath Exposed: Unexpected Discoveries, Compelling Evidence**: A comprehensive, scripture-dense study of the Sabbath-Sunday question from Genesis to Revelation written in a scholarly register.
  - Paperback: https://link.amazon/B04mpbbe3
  - Hardcover: https://link.amazon/B09bVd7FQ

## Author Storefronts & Catalogs

- Amazon Author Storefront (All Books): https://link.amazon/B0d7OqgeW

## About the Author

Rev. Mark L. Moody has spent over forty-five years in full-time evangelical pastoral ministry. Originally from Washington State, he spent much of his ministry in British Columbia, Canada, where he served as a youth pastor, devoted a decade to Teen Challenge, and pastored churches for more than thirty years. He currently assists in leadership at a community church in California.

*Note on Affiliation:* Rev. Mark L. Moody has no connection or institutional affiliation with Moody Publishers (formerly Moody Press) or the Moody Bible Institute. "Moody" is his family surname.
